title: Capsizing Passenger Ferry in Stormy Seas
hook: You are trapped on a sinking ferry turning upside down—you have 60 seconds to learn how to survive.

steps.line: You are trapped on a sinking ferry turning upside down. Listen closely, you have sixty seconds to learn how to survive.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Inside the lower deck of a massive passenger ferry that is violently tilting sideways. PERSON: A distressed 30-year-old male passenger wearing a soaked casual jacket, sheer terror on his face, struggling to keep balance on the slanted metal floor. ENVIRONMENT: Sparks flying from broken overhead lights, dark cold ocean water rapidly rushing in through shattered windows, scattered luggage floating around. CAMERA: Medium shot, eye-level, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading, eerie emergency red lights flashing. DETAILS: Visible sweat, dirt, torn clothes, authentic survival urgency, photorealistic water physics. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, following the person's action, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The terrified passenger slips on the violently tilting wet deck, desperately grabbing onto a metal handrail to prevent falling into the rising dark water below. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, focused panic expression, dynamic water splashing. ENVIRONMENT: Pitch black ferry interior illuminated only by strobing red emergency lights, freezing water surging through the corridor, massive structural groaning sounds implied. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on determined face holding tight to the rail. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Step 1: Grab a life jacket immediately, but never inflate it inside. Rising water will suddenly trap you against the ceiling.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: A passenger urgently securing an uninflated bright orange life jacket inside the flooded cabin. PERSON: A young woman in wet casual clothes, fierce determination on her face, tightly adjusting the straps of the life vest. ENVIRONMENT: The ferry cabin ceiling is dangerously close as the water level rises up to her chest, submerged chairs and debris floating chaotically around her, dark claustrophobic space. CAMERA: Medium shot, eye-level, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural ambient light from a distant broken window, high contrast, cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Visible sweat, dripping wet hair, realistic water reflections, authentic bright orange survival gear securely fastened. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, following the person's action, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The woman rapidly snaps the buckles of the orange life jacket across her chest, intentionally keeping her hands away from the inflation pull-tabs while pushing through waist-deep water. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, focused expression, strong purposeful hand gestures. ENVIRONMENT: Rapidly flooding ferry corridor, water swirling violently against the walls, debris blocking the main passageway, claustrophobic and sinking atmosphere. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on her determined face as she turns toward the only available exit. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Step 2: Avoid large panicked crowds. Stay low, follow the wall with your hands, and move toward the nearest emergency exit.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Passenger crawling through a smoky, water-filled corridor away from a panicking crowd. PERSON: A rugged middle-aged man, soaked and exhausted, keeping his body low to the flooded floor, running his bare hands along the riveted metal wall. ENVIRONMENT: The hallway is completely tilted at a 45-degree angle, dense smoke and emergency foam reducing visibility, a chaotic blur of panicked passengers in the distant background, a glowing green exit sign above an alternative door. CAMERA: Medium shot, low-angle, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading, glowing green emergency lights cutting through mist. DETAILS: Visible sweat, dirt, bleeding knuckles, authentic survival gear. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, trailing the man closely at floor level, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The man pushes forward through thigh-deep dark water, his hand sliding across the cold steel bulkhead to guide himself blindly toward the alternative emergency exit door, ignoring the chaotic crowd behind him. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, intense focused expression, heavy physical exertion. ENVIRONMENT: Severely slanted ship interior, sparks dropping from exposed wiring, freezing ocean water churning in the dark corridor, claustrophobic industrial setting. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on his hand successfully grabbing the heavy metal latch of the exit door. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Step 3: Brace for freezing water. Cover your nose and mouth with one hand to prevent the deadly cold shock reflex.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: A passenger standing at the edge of the sinking deck, preparing to hit the freezing ocean water. PERSON: A 25-year-old male with a shaved head, wearing an uninflated life jacket, tightly clamping one hand over his nose and mouth, eyes locked on the terrifying jump below. ENVIRONMENT: Massive stormy ocean waves crashing violently against the rusted hull of the vertically tilting ferry, freezing rain pouring down, dark terrifying marine environment. CAMERA: Medium shot, slightly low-angle, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading, flashes of lightning illuminating the stormy sea. DETAILS: Visible freezing rain, wind-whipped clothes, realistic skin textures, authentic survival urgency, absolute terror mixed with resolve. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, pushing in on the person's face, slight camera shake for realism in the strong wind. ACTION: He takes a rapid deep breath, firmly clamps his right hand across his mouth and nose, and crosses his left arm over his chest to secure his life jacket just before stepping off the edge. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, focused expression bracing for impact, wind violently blowing his wet clothes. ENVIRONMENT: Freezing hurricane-force storm, massive dark blue waves swelling beneath the teetering edge of the massive passenger ship, torrential rain blurring the entire background. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on his intense, determined face the precise millisecond he steps off the ledge into the void. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Step 4: Step off the ship feet first. Never dive headfirst, and strictly avoid jumping directly into those crowded lifeboats.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Mid-air shot of the passenger jumping off the sinking hull into the raging open ocean. PERSON: The determined man falling straight down feet-first, arms crossed tightly over his chest, life jacket secured, legs crossed at the ankles. ENVIRONMENT: Gigantic violent ocean waves rising to meet him, an overcrowded rescue lifeboat bobbing precariously to the left which he is intentionally avoiding, the massive rusted propellers of the capsized ferry looming behind him. CAMERA: Medium-wide shot, eye-level tracking the fall, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading, dark stormy skies. DETAILS: Perfect vertical falling posture, realistic water spray, authentic survival gear, dramatic scale comparing the tiny human to the giant teetering ship and ocean waves. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, panning down rapidly to follow the person's descent, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The man plummets toward the ocean in a strict pencil-dive formation, feet first, actively steering his fall away from a floating piece of heavy debris and the crowded lifeboats directly below. MOTION: Realistic human movement, high-speed physics, urgency in body language, focused expression. ENVIRONMENT: Raging stormy sea, violent wind and heavy rain, the towering dark hull of the sinking ferry dominating the extreme background, chaotic ocean waves churning. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on his feet beautifully piercing the surface of the violently swirling dark water. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Step 5: Swim away quickly to escape that massive deadly suction. Save this video right now, it could save your life.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: A survivor swimming frantically away from the massive vortex created by the sinking ship. PERSON: A heavily breathing survivor floating in a bright orange life jacket, furiously doing the backstroke while looking back in pure terror at the sinking vessel. ENVIRONMENT: Gigantic whirlpool forming as the massive steel ferry slips beneath the giant stormy waves, pulling debris down into the dark abyss, towering waves threatening to crash over him safely at a distance. CAMERA: Medium shot, low water-level angle, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading, cold bleak dawn light breaking through heavy storm clouds. DETAILS: Visible water droplets on the lens, freezing wet skin, overwhelming exhaustion, realistic water foam, authentic inflated survival gear. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot, at water level following the swimmer, slight camera shake for realism mimicking floating in rough stormy seas. ACTION: The survivor kicks wildly backwards in the freezing ocean, pulling the inflation tabs of his life vest now that he is completely clear of the sinking ship's dangerous suction zone. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, desperate focused expression, massive physical effort fighting the cresting waves. ENVIRONMENT: Violent stormy ocean, a terrifying massive whirlpool spiraling violently in the background where the ship just disappeared, floating broken luggage passing quickly by. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on his determined, absolutely exhausted face as he finally reaches a safe distance and looks directly into the camera. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.
